steps.observation: MIMIC-III is a freely available, deidentified database containing electronic health records of patients admitted to an Intensive Care Unit (ICU) at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2001 and 2012. The database contains all of the notes associated with each patient's time spent in the ICU as well as 55,177 discharge reports and 4,475 discharge addendums for 41,127 distinct patients. Only the original discharge reports were included in our analyses. Each discharge summary was divided into sections (Date of Birth, Sex, Chief Complaint, Major Surgical or Invasive Procedure, History of Present Illness, etc.) using a regular expression.
